simple.meaning: עָרִיף (ʻârîyph) is a Hebrew word meaning “the sky (as drooping at the horizon).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.short: the sky (as drooping at the horizon)
definitions.full: H6183. ariph [ עָרִיף ] noun [masculine] cloud ; — plural suffix בַּעֲרִיפֶיהָ Isa 5:30 (Perles JQ 1899, 689 proposes יָפְיָהּ בְּעַד , referring suffix to ארץ , and compare Psa 139:11 ).
